2072 /* Copy YYSRC to YYDEST, returning the address of the terminating '\0' in
2073  YYDEST. */
2074 static char *
2075 yystpcpy (char *yydest, const char *yysrc)
2076 {
2077  char *yyd = yydest;
2078  const char *yys = yysrc;
2079 
2080  while ((*yyd++ = *yys++) != '\0')
2081  continue;

2088 # ifndef yytnamerr
2089 /* Copy to YYRES the contents of YYSTR after stripping away unnecessary
2090  quotes and backslashes, so that it's suitable for yyerror. The
2091  heuristic is that double-quoting is unnecessary unless the string
2092  contains an apostrophe, a comma, or backslash (other than
2093  backslash-backslash). YYSTR is taken from yytname. If YYRES is
2094  null, do not copy; instead, return the length of what the result
2095  would have been. */
2096 static YYSIZE_T
2097 yytnamerr (char *yyres, const char *yystr)
2098 {
2099  if (*yystr == '"')
2100  {
2101  YYSIZE_T yyn = 0;
2102  char const *yyp = yystr;
2103 
2104  for (;;)
2105  switch (*++yyp)
2106  {
2107  case '\'':
2108  case ',':
2109  goto do_not_strip_quotes;
2110 
2111  case '\\':
2112  if (*++yyp != '\\')
2113  goto do_not_strip_quotes;
2114  /* Fall through. */
2115  default:
2116  if (yyres)
2117  yyres[yyn] = *yyp;
2118  yyn++;
2119  break;
2120 
2121  case '"':
2122  if (yyres)
2123  yyres[yyn] = '\0';
2124  return yyn;
2125  }
2126  do_not_strip_quotes: ;
2127  }
2128 
2129  if (! yyres)
2130  return yystrlen (yystr);
2131 
2132  return yystpcpy (yyres, yystr) - yyres;
2133 }
2134 # endif

2136 /* Copy into *YYMSG, which is of size *YYMSG_ALLOC, an error message
2137  about the unexpected token YYTOKEN for the state stack whose top is
2138  YYSSP.
2139 
2140  Return 0 if *YYMSG was successfully written. Return 1 if *YYMSG is
2141  not large enough to hold the message. In that case, also set
2142  *YYMSG_ALLOC to the required number of bytes. Return 2 if the
2143  required number of bytes is too large to store. */
2144 static int
2145 yysyntax_error (YYSIZE_T *yymsg_alloc, char **yymsg,
2146  yytype_int16 *yyssp, int yytoken)
2147 {
